segments.ja398:1.1: Rājā te bhattaṃ pāhesi, suciṃ maṃsūpasecanaṃ;
segments.ja398:1.3: Maghadevasmiṃ [makhādevasmiṃ (sī. pī.), māghadevasmiṃ (ka.)] adhivatthe, ehi nikkhamma bhuñjassu.
segments.ja398:2.3: Tvañca māṇava bhikkhā ca [bhakkhosi (syā.), bhakkhāva (ka.)], ubho bhakkhā bhavissatha.
segments.ja398:4.1: Laddhāya yakkhā [laddhāyaṃ yakkha (sī. syā. pī.)] tava niccabhikkhaṃ, suciṃ paṇītaṃ rasasā upetaṃ;
segments.ja398:4.3: Bhikkhañca te āhariyo naro idha, sudullabho hehiti bhakkhite [khādite (sī. syā. pī.)] mayi.
segments.ja398:5.1: Mameva [mamesa (sī. pī.)] sutano attho, yathā bhāsasi māṇava;
segments.ja398:5.3: Mayā tvaṃ samanuññāto, sotthiṃ passāhi mātaraṃ.
segments.ja398:6.1: Khaggaṃ chattañca pātiñca, gacchamādāya [gacchevādāya (sī. syā. pī.)] māṇava;
segments.ja398:6.3: Sotthiṃ passatu te mātā, tvañca passāhi mātaraṃ.
segments.ja398:7.1: Evaṃ yakkha sukhī hohi, saha sabbehi ñātibhi;
segments.ja398:7.3: Dhanañca me adhigataṃ, rañño ca vacanaṃ katanti.
